source_units.text: A theatre induction includes a paper-based rigging quiz.
Arrange my theory revision into manageable sessions.
Use the exact labels "Load Paths", "Counterweight Systems", "Rigging Inspections" in the schedule, with at least 25 total minutes assigned to each.
Within that coverage, "Load Paths" needs at least 35 total minutes.
There is a firm ceiling of 30 study minutes on each date.
The last usable study date is 2027-02-06, and sessions may fall on that day.
